One Pot South Indian Khichdi 
this recipe will not be typical or something you expect, i honestly dont even know if its a thing already since i just mixed flavours together and had fun with it :) 

try it out and let me know what you think!! 

Nutrition: 
C: 45 | F: 2 | P: 9
Calories: 239 per portion 
Makes 3 portions

Ingredient 
1/2 cup rice ( approx 100 grams)
1/4 cup toor OR masoor dal, your life your rules ;) (approx 50 grams) 
1 tsp ghee OR oil to make it vegan
1 tsp mustard seeds
1/2 tsp jeera 
pinch of hing
2 green chilli, split
one spring curry leaves
8-10 shallots OR 1 onion, sliced
8 garlic cloves, whole or chopped
2 tomatoes, roughly chopped
2 tbsp rasam podi OR sambar podi :) 
1 lemon size ball of tamarind soaked in 3 cups of water 
salt, to taste 
coriander, to garnish 

Method
prep ahead: 
wash and soak the rice + dal together for 30-45 minutes
soak the tamarind in 3 cups water for minimum 30 minutes and strain

cooking: 
add oil to the pressure cooker and add in the jeera and mustard seeds with a pinch of hing 
follow that up with green chilli, curry leaves and shallots + garlic and stir for a few minutes
add in the tomatoes and cook for 1-2 minutes
add in the podi and tamarind water and stir together 
seal the pressure cooker and allow to cook on medium for 3-4 whistles
let the pressure release, stir together and top with fresh coriander and enjoy with dahi and maybe some banana chips for extra crunch :)
